item.title: Government criticised over latest homelessness figures
item.description: The government is coming under renewed attack following the publication of the latest homelessness figures. They reveal almost 17 thousand people - including a record 5 thousand 321 children - started the new year in emergency accommodation. It represents another rise in homelessness in November, up 230 on October and a 12 per cent rise over the past year. Advertisement Aontú leader and Meath West TD Peader Tóibín says thousands of local authority homes are lying empty.

item.title: Arson investigation launched after cars set alight in Meath
item.description: An investigation is underway into an arson attack in Duleek in County Meath. Gardaí and fire crews from both Drogheda and Navan responded to reports of eight cars on fire in the car park of a pub on Main Street shortly before 11 o'clock last night. Staff and customers, as well as others staying in accommodation there, were safely evacuated from the building. Advertisement No injuries were reported, and the scene has been preserved for a technical examination today.

item.description: A local woman has emphasised the importance of supporting local businesses. Cootehill Chamber secretary Connie Whelan says people spending their money locally makes a bigger difference than supporting bigger chains. Local businesses support sports and community events all year round, and if they are not supported they unfortunately will not survive. item.title: Cavan farmer warns lack of time harming farmers’ health
item.description: A Cavan farmer believes lack of free time can lead to farmers neglecting their own health. Young farmer and social media creator Sophie Bell says long hours often mean farmers skip doctor's visits, exercise and time with friends. She warns the pressure of balancing everything on the farm can push younger people away from the industry, especially during tougher winter months. item.description: Christine Wynne of SOSAD Cavan is encouraging people to "check in" on those who are finding this time of year particularly difficult. Christine says many people struggle this time of year, however knowing that someone is thinking of them can make all the difference. Bereavement and additional financial pressures are just some of the factors that can impact someone's mental health over the Christmas period. item.title: Status yellow snow and ice warning in place across Northern Sound region
item.description: A status yellow snow and ice warning is in place across the entire Northern Sound region this evening. It affects both Cavan and Monaghan from 6pm today until 11am tomorrow. Temperatures are set to fall as low as minus four degrees, with wintry showers, frost and icy patches expected. Advertisement Drivers are being urged to avoid unnecessary travel, with hazardous conditions and poor visibility forecast. item.title: Man aged in his 30s dies in Longford collision
item.description: Gardaí and emergency services are currently attending the scene of a fatal road traffic collision on the N4 at Edgeworthstown, Co. Longford this evening, Saturday, 3rd January 2026. The collision involved two cars and a van and occurred on the Longford Town side of the N4 after the Edgeworthstown Roundabout at approximately 7pm.
